name: Virtual Mind Holding Company Limited
summary: Virtual Mind Holding Company Limited, an investment holding company, designs, manufactures, and trades in apparels in the United States, Hong Kong, and internationally. The company provides its products under private labels and own brands. It also provides designing, marketing, and advertising services; and money lending services to individual consumers and small businesses. The company was formerly known as Runway Global Holdings Company Limited and changed its name to Virtual Mind Holding Company Limited in October 2017. Virtual Mind Holding Company Limited was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Wanchai, Hong Kong.
